group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: The month and year in which the applicant expects to finish the degree, as written in the form.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: How many months the applicant will study during the grant year (September 2027 to August 2028), counted from the completion date in the form. A student who finishes in January 2028 studies 5 months, and the award shrinks with the months.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: The same number of months, estimated from the CSV alone (from the courses passed per semester). It shows what a group without the forms could know; it often differs from the form.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: The savings the applicant will still have in September 2027: today's savings minus twelve months of today's monthly gap. Money spent before the grant starts cannot pay for the grant year.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: The purpose for which the applicant keeps the savings, when the form names one, such as a child or a parent's medical treatment. Savings kept for dependants or for medical care count as unavailable for studying.
values: for dependants · for family medical costs · for a move or deposit · for after graduation · empty when the form names no purpose

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: What happens to another scholarship the applicant receives: it continues, it ends before the grant year (and so leaves the 2027/28 budget), or its end date is uncertain.
values: none · continues (as far as stated) · ends before grant year · end date uncertain

group_name: A and B · Need and eligibility
meaning: 1 when the applicant describes a recent event that threatens the money the family sends, such as a parent's job loss, illness or retirement.

group_name: A and B · Need and eligibility
meaning: 1 when the family could help but has stopped helping, for example after the applicant had to leave the family home.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: Need, first reading: the monthly gap written in the form, multiplied by 12. It takes the form's number at face value.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: Need, second reading: the money missing for the grant year, computed from the CSV only. Expenses minus family support and expected income, for the estimated months, minus other scholarships and all savings.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: Need, third reading: the money missing for the grant year, using the forms as well. It counts the months stated in the form, only the scholarships that continue, and only the savings still available in September 2027. The most complete measure of need.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: The call's maximum award for the applicant's study level (Bachelor's CHF 8,000, Master's CHF 6,500, Doctoral CHF 5,000), reduced in proportion when the applicant studies fewer than 12 months of the grant year.

group_name: A · Need in the grant year
meaning: The most the applicant can receive: the smaller of the need for the grant year (shortfall_text) and the call's maximum for the study level (level_max_prorated).

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: The call excludes Permit C holders with significant family resources. This variable marks Permit C holders whose family earns more than CHF 6,000 a month: 'rule applies' when the form shows the family money is available, 'exception candidate' when the form shows it is at risk or withdrawn.
values: not concerned · rule applies · exception candidate

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: The reason a Permit B holder has the permit, as stated in the form: study, family, work or refugee. The reason matters: the rules on full-time study and on working hours concern study permits only.
values: study · family · work · refugee · not stated · empty for applicants with another permit

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: The largest number of working hours per week that the applicant mentions in the form.
values: hours; empty when the form gives no number

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: 1 when a student with a study permit studies part-time or works more than 15 hours a week: the two limits that come with a study permit.

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: 1 when a part-time Permit B holder gives no reason for the permit. A question for the committee to clarify.

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: 1 when the applicant is waiting for a decision on the residence permit. The call allows an award on condition that the permit is granted.

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: 1 when an applicant with a pending permit writes that the grant would serve as the proof of money that the migration office asks for.

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: 1 when an applicant with a pending permit writes that working is forbidden while reporting an income. A consistency check.

group_name: B · Eligibility and legal conditions
meaning: For doctoral applicants: 1 when the form cites a written confirmation, such as a supervisor's letter, that the university offers no funding, as the call requires; 0 when the form cites none.
values: 1 · 0 · empty for applicants at other levels

group_name: C · Low GPA
meaning: 1 when the GPA is below 2.5, the call's usual minimum.

group_name: C · Low GPA
meaning: For applicants with a GPA below 2.5: whether the form explains the low grades and shows improvement. The call accepts a low GPA when the applicant does both.
values: not concerned · explained and improving · explained, no improvement shown · not explained

group_name: D · Use of the grant and candour
meaning: Costs that the applicant mentions and that the grant excludes, such as family members' expenses, debt repayment, childcare or travel home. A mention explains the applicant's situation; it excludes nobody.
values: list of cost types; empty when the form mentions none

group_name: D · Use of the grant and candour
meaning: 1 when the applicant writes that their costs are covered today.

group_name: D · Use of the grant and candour
meaning: 1 when the applicant writes that others need the grant more.

group_name: D · Use of the grant and candour
meaning: 1 when the text says 'no gap' while the numbers in the same form show a gap of at least CHF 500 a month. A question for the committee to clarify.

group_name: E · Quality of the ticked boxes
meaning: How many ticked boxes (risks and strengths) the applicant leaves without an explanation in the statement.

group_name: E · Quality of the ticked boxes
meaning: How many risk boxes (for example 'Family emergency situation') the applicant explains only with a sentence copied word for word in other forms. Such a sentence gives no personal detail.

group_name: E · Quality of the ticked boxes
meaning: The same for the strength boxes (work, volunteering, leadership, community engagement, overcoming adversity): how many the applicant explains only with a copied sentence.

group_name: E · Quality of the ticked boxes
meaning: Circumstances that the applicant describes in the statement without ticking the box.
values: list of boxes; empty when there are none

group_name: E · Quality of the ticked boxes
meaning: How many risk boxes the applicant explains with a personal, specific description.

group_name: Control · not a criterion
meaning: The number of words in the three written statements. Length is not a criterion: notebook 2 uses it only to check whether longer texts received more money.
